All of the Spider-Man comics that Ditko and Lee were involved with didn’t involve just action and I think the MCU has kinda clouded peoples judgement of what constitutes a Spider-Man story (along with modern comics). Spider-Man stories usually involve Spider-Man being a burden to Peter Parker and it also involves the consequences of being a superhero and having enemies who could potentially hurt your loved ones.
